condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: In 2024, the Government continued advancing the justice for children agenda by strengthening child-friendly procedures for protection of child victims and witnesses and initiating diversion modelling. Advocacy and support for strengthening child protection institutional and normative systems continue as part of a broader programme to support families, especially those most in need.

actual.value: 2024:The draft National Social Services Development Plan, which includes expanding social work services nationwide, developing a licensing system, supervision and strengthening the data collection system, was not approved in 2024 as expected

title.narrative: Existence of legislation that recognize children's right to be heard in civil and administrative proceedings that affect them (in line with Article 12 of the CRC) (23-01-L3-07), Text

baseline.value: NO. It is assessed that such legislation is not in place, particularly for the administrative proceedings, although the exact baseline status is yet to be established

target.value: 2025:YES. Legislation exists with an explicit reference to children’s right to be heard, including potential age limits

actual.value: 2024:Some amendments to criminal and civil legislation have been endorsed by the Government. Pending Parlament approval

title.narrative: Existence of procedures and services for children in contact with law that are applied and delivered in line with international norms (23-03-L3-03), Text

baseline.value: NO. The main focus of the reform in the country was children in conflict with law

target.value: 2025:YES. Child-friendly investigation, trial and sentencing procedures by police, prosecutors, defence counsel and judges, including special protection measures for child victims and witnesses are improved

actual.value: 2024:A special course on a child-friendly approach to investigating crimes against children has been developed with the aim of integrating it further as a training module for the Institute of the MIA students and in-service training for police investigators an

title.narrative: An alternative care policy in line with the 2009 Guidelines for the Alternative Care of Children is available in the country (23-03-L3-01), Text

baseline.value: Partially. Some elements of the Guidelines have already been integrated

target.value: 2025:Elements of the Guidelines are integrated into the strategy (policy)

actual.value: 2024:Based on the discussed concept for the development of alternative care and taking into account that this is an intersectoral issue, the relevant ministries agreed to develop a detailed subject for approval next year
